## Addendum (2026-09-19, from the B3 handback; B5 owns `app/routes/__root.tsx`)
- Duplicate canonical: `createTwilightRootRoute` emits a site-wide `<link rel="canonical">` from `buildBaseHead` (engine chunk-TZ3E5BN4.js:61-68) and every route head adds its own, so pages carry two. In `__root.tsx`, post-process the root head (or the `head` option the root route accepts, verify in the dist) so the engine's base canonical link is dropped and only the route-level, locale-prefixed one remains; add a test that a rendered head has exactly one canonical.
- `body` carries `color-mode-dark` on the live store (a store or SDK setting); the theme is light-mode only. In the root route, on the client, remove `color-mode-dark` from `document.body.classList` after hydration and make sure nothing in our layout adds it; do not change the store setting.
- `twilight.json` already carries every gate setting (`reply_sla_hours`, `consultation_credit_note`, `claim_official_distributors`, `show_newsletter`, `branch_map_url`, `branch_landmark`, `pickup_ready_hours`, `pickup_hold_days`); read them defensively.
- Locale values use i18next double braces (`{{threshold}}`), never single. Prices: never read `product.sale_price` directly (the API sends 0 when not on sale); use `effectivePrice()` from `app/components/product/lib/claims.ts` if you show a price on a service card, or the `Price` primitive with the engine's `starting_price ?? price` rule.
- `content/services.ts` exists (three channels with OX codes and keys); the PDP builder left the ServicePdp "what to bring", "how it works" and "other channels" blocks for later because they need the same wiring as your hub: if time allows, export a small `ServiceSteps` component from `app/components/pages/` and tell the conductor so the PDP can import it between waves.
